heading, Spire Ella May Barnes Clinic, level 1

Spire Ella May Barnes Clinic is a premium private clinic located in the historical city of Norwich. Our team of experienced consultants provide fast access to a wide range of treatments in our new state of the art facility.

The clinic is home to our dedicated eye centre and outpatient physiotherapy team as well as offering neurology, cardiology, psychology, respiratory, diabetes, endocrinology, pain medicine and colorectal services.
If further treatment or surgery is required, this will take place at Spire Norwich Hospital and will be carried out under the care of the same consultant.

end of heading, Travel instructions, level 2

Spire Ella May Barnes Clinic is situated just off the A47 southern bypass, close to the University of East Anglia and just 3 miles from the city centre. Norwich is just over 100 miles from London and Stansted Airport is approximately 75 minutes by car.

Follow the B1108 (Earlham Road) out of Norwich passing the University of East Anglia on the left, heading towards Norwich Research Park. Continue on the B1108 (now Watton Road) going past Spire Norwich Hospital on your right-hand side. Continue past the turning for the Norfolk and Norwich hospital and take the left hand turning onto Hethersett Lane. At the roundabout, take the first exit onto Rosalind Franklin Road. At the next roundabout take the first exit and stay on Rosalind Franklin Road. Continue straight, the Spire Ella May Barnes Clinic will be on your left-hand side. The building itself is located opposite The Quadram Institute and The Bob Champion Building
Leave the A47 at the B1108 junction signposted Norwich/Watton.
At the roundabout follow the B1108 (Watton Road), continue along the B1108 towards Norwich.

At the first set of traffic lights turn right onto Hethersett Lane. At the roundabout, take the first exit onto Rosalind Franklin Road. At the next roundabout take the first exit and stay on Rosalind Franklin Road. Continue straight, the Spire Ella May Barnes Clinic will be on your left-hand side. The building itself is located opposite The Quadram Institute and The Bob Champion Building.
There are a limited number of drop off and pick up spaces available at the front of the building. Parking is available in the multi-storey NRP car park located to the south of the building.
Accessible parking bays are located at the front of the building.
Spire Ella May Barnes Clinic is approximately three miles from Norwich train station.
